svg.title: History-guided search-state selection for SGLA UAV tracking
svg.desc: Solid teal arrows show the response-selection route. Amber dashed boxes show the tested learned-scoring alternative. Each crop is processed separately by the same fixed SGLA-based tracker E: six prefix blocks and one independent candidate. Only accepted past predictions enter history. Future images and ground truth are used only for offline scorer labels.
svg.text: History-guided Search-State Selection for SGLA UAV Tracking
Problem: predicted boxes determine future crops; center and scale errors can alter response competition and cause persistent drift.
One fixed tracker, evaluated separately per crop
(a) Online: own history → center × size proposals → SGLA → selection → own history
Accepted history only; probes stay separate
Original first-frame template z₀ stays fixed
Current image for all four crops
Original selector: choose ONE independent candidate
OR: learned scoring, a separate policy
Parameters fitted from offline branch returns
Use one scoring rule; do not combine them
Use it for the next frame
Closed-loop feedback: the accepted box changes future proposals, crops and visual evidence
Budget: 4 full searches per frame for each selector; 1 for current-only control. Search features are not shared across crops.
(b) Offline: matched-start utility supervision for the learned alternative
Future images and GT: fit-split labels only
Fixed E generates its own history
Same four proposals at each anchor
Change the first parent only; then ordinary E rollout
Attach fit GT after predictions; IoU is on 0–1 scale
One-action return, not the value of repeated selection
Fit a linear scorer for each target
Ridge, no intercept; λ = 0.01; current score = 0
Matched features, samples, capacity and regularizer
θ₁ / θ₈ serve the dashed route; SGLA stays fixed
Learned policies and response control use the same four-probe budget; offline GT and future frames never enter the online actor.
E: existing geometry-adapted endpoint-preservation tracker (Stages 54 / 58), fixed here. Proposals and scoring follow Stage 60; dashed scoring is a tested exploratory alternative.
